subject: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — please verify impact on live workloads
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acmeanalytics.com>; ops@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — please verify impact on live workloads

Hi Jared / Acme ops team,

Quick heads up — during routine scheduler tuning we observed an allocator edge-case that can lead to transient OOM spikes on long-running batched requests at high sequence lengths. Engineering validated a small runtime patch that reduces the window where the allocator can enter an inconsistent state; we plan to push a micro-hotfix to your dedicated pool in the next 30 minutes.

What to expect:
- Brief (~2–5 min) rolling restart of the worker group; no configuration changes.
- Expected impact: short error spikes for inflight batched requests; we will hold new large-batch routing during the rollout.
- Post-patch verification: please run the attached verification-script.sh on a representative job and report any error patterns.

Action requested from you:
1) Confirm you are ready for a short rolling restart now (we can delay by up to 20 minutes).
2) After we signal completion, run the verification script and reply with the output or any anomalies.

Attached: hotfix-checklist.pdf (internal ops checklist), verification-script.sh (simple curl-based test).

I’ll post a short update once the rollout begins. Apologies for the short notice — we’re prioritizing a minimal-notice mitigation over extended exposure.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hotfix-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: verification-script.sh (shell script, 3KB)]

From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Aug 2029 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — please verify impact on live workloads

Thanks Priyom — we appreciate the heads up. Ops here can take the short restart now. Two quick Qs:
1) Do you have an estimated start + finish timestamp?
2) Any chance this will affect data retention or K/V cache consistency for in-flight sessions?

I’ll run the verification script once you give the all-clear.

— Jared
SRE Lead, Acme Analytics

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Aug 2029 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — coordination

Marissa / Ben — Jared confirmed they can take the short restart now. Checklist below and rollback plan:
- Start: 09:40 PT (target)
- Rolling restart: 3 worker shards, 90s drain per shard
- Rollback: immediate pinned image bump to previous stable build (automated) if error rate > 2% for 5m
- Notify: Slack #cust-acme and open a Zoom if customer requests deeper troubleshooting

I’ll perform the rollout and post the completion timestamp to this thread. Marissa, please shadow logs for KV cache misalignment (INF-9876 tag); Ben, keep an eye on the canary metrics and be ready to trigger rollback.

Forwarded message: see original to Acme.

Priyom
[Attachment: hotfix-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acmeanalytics.com>; ops@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Aug 2029 09:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — please verify impact on live workloads

Update: rollout started at 09:46 PT. We performed a rolling restart of the three worker shards; total disruption window was ~4 minutes. No rollback was necessary.

Please run the verification script now (attached) and paste the first 20 lines of the output here. Look specifically for any 5xx spikes tied to batch-run requests. If you see anything concerning, we’ll open a live debug session immediately.

For transparency, we’re drafting a short postmortem and will share the link once the initial write-up is ready. For internal traceability we created ticket INF-9876.

Thanks for the quick coordination — sorry again for the short notice.

Priyom
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: verification-script.sh (shell script, 3KB)]

From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 11 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: allocator micro-hotfix activation — please verify impact on live workloads

All good from our side — ran the script against a 12-minute representative job (attached snippet). No 5xxs observed, latency returned to expected baselines after the 4-minute window. We’ll keep a closer eye on longer batch windows over the next 24 hours and post anything odd to your Escalations channel.

Thanks for the quick resolution and the clear rollback plan. Looking forward to the postmortem link.

— Jared
SRE Lead, Acme Analytics
